title: ExecutionEnvironment: NativeSandboxEnvironment + migration
description:
Implement NativeSandboxEnvironment and migrate from ToolBackend to ExecutionEnvironment. From docs/plans/11-sandbox-host-service.add01.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §5.2 (NativeSandboxEnvironment), §7 (migration path), §8 (snapshot handling)

Key deliverables:
- NativeSandboxEnvironment in internal/sandbox/environment/native/:
  - Wraps existing ConnectRPC SandboxClient
  - Full lifecycle: Create/Pause/Resume/Destroy map to RPC calls
  - ExecuteTool dispatches via existing SandboxClient.ExecuteToolStream
  - Snapshots: CreateSnapshot, Rollback, TurnComplete via RPC
  - State() queries server or tracks locally
  - sync.RWMutex for concurrent access (lifecycle vs ExecuteTool)
  - Capabilities() returns NativeSandboxCapabilities
- Migration:
  - Update agent loop to use ExecutionEnvironment instead of ToolBackend
  - Update RuntimeController to create/manage ExecutionEnvironment
  - Remove ToolBackend interface, LocalBackend, SandboxBackend, SandboxToolClient
  - Environment selection factory: NewEnvironment(config) → ExecutionEnvironment
- Unit tests for NativeSandboxEnvironment (mock RPC client)
- Integration tests verifying migration doesn't break existing functionality
- Contract compliance suite passes for NativeSandboxEnvironment

Depends on: T1 (interface + LocalEnvironment must exist first)

AC: NativeSandboxEnvironment passes contract compliance, ToolBackend removed, agent loop uses ExecutionEnvironment, all existing tests pass after migration.
